# Video deliverables

Required production filenames:

- `demo.mp4` — narrated workflow demonstration
- `poster.webp` — video poster image
- `captions.vtt` — captions aligned to the final recording
- `transcript.md` — reviewed transcript aligned to the final recording

`demo.mp4` and `poster.webp` are pending and intentionally not represented by fabricated binaries. Replace the draft caption and transcript outline when the recording is produced.
